limitations: The official table explicitly includes both past and current courses. No course recommendation version, effective date, completion date or degree catalog is printed in these rows.
Blank Date Restrictions cells are retained as unknown; they do not prove a recommendation or catalog is current.
The university labels Target Units as potentially the maximum possible amount. No individual credit award is established.
Source Units are reported by the receiving university and do not independently verify original provider credit quantities, units, level or active ACE version.
Printed GLO and core labels are retained verbatim. They are not assigned to the eight-outcome 2026–2027 GEC without separate cohort evidence.
Rows labeled More... require their actual detail panel; Not Accepted and incomplete rows are preserved separately.
